quotes.text: // Make sure to select the panel before potentially auto-focusing the button.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current selectPanel assigns updateDeck.selectedPanel before finding/focusing the new button. The code explicitly documents this order. Focus must target a visible active panel, and a decorative icon state change is insufficient to establish that active panel. No keyboard interaction test was run.
title: Select the updater panel before moving keyboard focus
